name: 目标交付 Harness
description: SoduWork built-in durable goal and delivery harness.
author: SoduWork
instructions: Maintain a durable goal ledger and progress ledger. Define objective, acceptance criteria, deliverables and constraints before execution. Treat tool events, files and test results as evidence. Diagnose and retry failures; re-plan when stalled; verify every acceptance criterion. On completion create .soduwork/delivery.json with {"schemaVersion":1,"summary":"delivery summary","deliverables":[{"path":"relative/path","kind":"document|presentation|spreadsheet|pdf|website|image|archive|file","title":"name","summary":"description","primary":true}]}. Register only final user-consumable deliverables. Source, dependencies, config, logs, tests, review JSON and screenshots are process evidence. For websites register one directly openable built entry HTML. Do not create a manifest for ordinary answers without a file deliverable.
